description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Application Gateway operations

checks: Application Gateway provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed
backendAddressPools are correctly configured with target FQDNs or IPs
routing rules (path-based/basic) match the requested listener configuration
SKU name and tier match the requested Application Gateway tier (WAF_v2/Standard_v2)
Delete Application Gateway operations include pre-confirmation show command
WAF policy changes include pre-check of current policy state
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
Gateway deletion warns about traffic disruption to all configured backends
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Backend pool updates merge rather than replace existing pool members
Routing rule creation checks for listener name conflicts
Delete operations on already-deleted gateways return success
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Listener configuration (ports, protocols, certificates) is documented
Health probe settings and backend health status are logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Application Gateway name follows Azure naming conventions
--location parameter is specified for gateway creation
